template:
Hi,

Noticed that you handle {{business_type}} in {{city}}.

We help you generate 10 qualified {{inspection_type}} that turn into paid {{project_type}} jobs, in under 30 days.

There's no pay unless I book you a qualified, confirmed {{inspection_singular}}.

Open to a 15-minute chat?

instructions.business_type: the trade this company leads with on its website, lowercase, 2-3 words, chosen from: foundation repair, basement waterproofing, crawl space repair, concrete leveling, house leveling, slab repair. Use the one they put first, not the one they list among many.
instructions.inspection_type: the first visit to a homeowner, plural, 1-3 words, in the company's own wording: e.g. foundation inspections, basement inspections, crawl space inspections, free estimates. Must NOT repeat the full business_type phrase.
instructions.inspection_singular: the singular of inspection_type, e.g. foundation inspection, basement inspection, free estimate.
instructions.project_type: the job noun, 1-2 words, that follows the visit: e.g. repair, waterproofing, encapsulation, lifting. Must NOT repeat business_type or inspection_type; it is the OUTCOME word only.
instructions.city: ONLY if the 'city' known fact is blank: the city this company is based in, from the website. Otherwise repeat the known city exactly.

rules: The four trade values must read naturally in one sentence without repeating each other: business_type names the trade once; inspection_type is the visit; project_type is the outcome.
